names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 30 Ιουνίου, «Άγιος Στέφανος του Τόμσκ», with the rank word left off.

death.note: saint.gr prints the year of death alone in its heading: «Άγιος Στέφανος του Τόμσκ (; - 1876)», the year of birth left as a question mark.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026). saint.gr itself calls him a Russian saint, so the Russian calendar is where his life will be.
